findings.F1: Step 5's main measure is on the opposite side to the idea's prediction: the correlation of the short forecast with the next 7-bar fall beyond drift is -0.135 (t -1.30, 93 grid cases). The idea's size is also negative: an unusual move of -0.69 % per case (t -0.83 over 160 days, strength -0.048 of a usual 12.44 % move, 195 cases). So the result is not a true effect that this data was too small to show.
findings.F2: In folds B and C, the rises inside the choppy agitated profile show no grading at 7 days: the correlation of the 7-day rise with the next 7 days' unusual move is -0.032 (t -0.15, 24 cases). Split by size of rise, the smallest third, middle third and largest third are followed by unusual moves of -0.38, -0.07 and -0.34 usual moves, so larger rises are not followed by larger falls.
findings.F3: Rises inside the profile do fall in the next 7 days (fall strength 0.257, t 2.46, 24 cases), but this is not a giving back of the rise. Weeks that fell inside the profile also keep falling: fall strength 0.404 (t 1.99, 40 cases) at 5 days and 0.089 (36 cases) at 7 days. What the test caught is a down drift of the profile itself, not the rise reversing.
findings.F4: No horizon shows a graded reversal inside the profile; the sign changes with the horizon. The rise-to-unusual-move correlation is +0.174 at 3 days, +0.276 at 5, -0.032 at 7, +0.304 at 10 and -0.229 at 14, all with t under 2 on 14 to 49 cases. Over 3 days, all moves in the profile continue rather than reverse (correlation +0.265, t 3.12, 131 cases).
findings.F5: The reversal is no stronger in the profile than outside it, which the brief names as a way its theory fails. The 7-day past-to-next correlation is -0.017 in the profile (60 cases) and +0.010 outside it (1041 cases). Outside the profile, rises are followed by further unusual rises (fall strength -0.053, t -1.15, 530 cases).
findings.F6: The effect is not stable across coins or windows. ZEC shows a reversal in the profile (correlation -0.395, t -1.49, 14 cases) while LTC shows continuation (+0.316, t 0.94, 10 cases). Window w17 shows a reversal (-0.590, t -2.19) while w16 shows continuation (+0.745, t 2.73). The book lost money: Sharpe -0.67 and -4.6 % a year.

no_ideas: The theme's effect is not in the data. The tested result points the wrong way (F1), and inside the choppy agitated profile larger weekly rises are not followed by larger falls at any horizon (F2, F4). The only fall seen follows rises and falls alike (F3), and the reversal is no stronger in the profile than outside it (F5), so no amended idea on the theme has a finding to rest on.
